title: Kalam Library Grand Opening & Timing Update
body: Library Study Hall is open from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM daily. High speed Wi-Fi and air conditioning available on Ground Floor and First Floor.

title: Library Operating Schedule & Quiet Study Hours
body: Ground Floor & First Floor study hall halls are open daily from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Please maintain silence in Section A and present your QR gate pass upon entrance.
